card.name: End of sentence introducing a table
card.fires_on: The word "below", the table number, or the period that ends a sentence saying a dosing table is shown or given. It fires right before the table itself begins.

modes.label: "below" after shown
modes.description: The word "below" in a sentence saying a schedule or table is shown beneath.
modes.example: The recommended dose titration schedule is shown in the table<< below>>. Dose titration, final dosage

modes.label: Period after table reference
modes.description: The period closing a sentence that points to a numbered dosing table, just before the table title.
modes.example: Patients Aged 2 to 12 Years Recommended dosing guidelines are summarized in Table 2<<.>> Lower starting doses and slower dose escalations

card.writes: It adds little visible output; it seems to prepare for a table or heading to start next.
card.plain: It lights up at the end of a sentence that says a dosing table follows.
